title: Tropical Crepe Fiesta
description: A delicious Mexican-inspired crepe filled with pomegranate salsa and topped with fresh pomegranate seeds. Perfect for a light and refreshing meal.

ingredients.name: French crepe batter
ingredients.notes: Make crepes according to package instructions

ingredients.name: Pomegranate salsa
ingredients.notes: Mix together 1/2 cup diced red onion, 1/4 cup diced fresh cilantro, 1 jalapeño pepper, seeded and finely chopped, and 2 tablespoons lime juice

instructions: Make crepes according to package instructions.
Mix together pomegranate salsa ingredients in a bowl.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Spoon about 1/4 cup of pomegranate salsa onto the center of a warmed tortilla.
Add a dollop of Greek yogurt and sprinkle with crumbled queso fresco or feta cheese if using.
Fold the bottom half of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the crepe into a tight cylinder.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
